_comment: The trap transcript. Almost nothing here is a real commitment... Danny closes with 'nothing today was a commitment, we were sizing.' A correct shelled extraction produces few items, null owners where ownership was left open, null priorities, and NO deadline anywhere (no date was ever stated). Naked mode reliably invents owners (Alex for the export, Sam for contract tests), deadlines ('before the Q3 renewal'), priorities, and a ticket for the digest bot that was explicitly rejected.

decisions.text: The Slack digest bot will explicitly NOT be the intern project because it touches prod credentials
No commitments were made in this meeting; all topics were sizing only

action_items.summary: Scope the audit log CSV export before committing to an approach
action_items.description: Enterprise customers (including Meridian, where it came up in the renewal call) keep asking for CSV export of the audit log. Estimates range from a day (full-table dump) to a week (streaming export with filters). Ownership was left open... Danny said 'somebody should scope that properly.' No deadline was stated; the renewal conversation has no known date.
action_items.evidence_quote: Somebody should scope that properly before we commit to anything.
acceptance_criteria: A written scope comparing dump vs streaming export options

action_items.summary: Add contract test suite on partner endpoints (unowned; blocks the search rewrite)
action_items.description: Sam will not start the search ranking rewrite without contract tests on the partner API endpoints, because the last ranking change broke the partner API for two weeks. Explicitly unowned as of this meeting.
action_items.evidence_quote: Not yet. It's unowned. It blocks the rewrite though, so it matters.
acceptance_criteria: Contract tests cover partner API endpoints affected by ranking changes
